Hi,
Just to expand a bit on my point.

- It costs about $30 on freelancer.com to get an image like this made and you can do deals with people to get 8-10 for $200.


I think your asking for too much $EDG based on what you are providing.

For me this points to a larger problem with the Edgeware system because no one is negotiating the pricing on behalf of the chain, and we are just accepting the amount people are putting up with no thought. People see what everyone else is getting paid and this problem only grows.

I think there is a role here for someone to negotiate the amount on behalf of Edgeware before these things get pushed into proposals.

> For me this points to a larger problem with the Edgeware system because no one is negotiating the pricing on behalf of the chain, and we are just accepting the amount people are putting up with no thought. People see what everyone else is getting paid and this problem only grows. 

Agree.

We definitely need some structures and standards going forward.

Tagging in [@ZOMBII](/edgeware/account/jYv1mozd5KbFGabpj9btRk6PhqoDpoASXhzsCgzc2QQXPHE) - we've been discussing this and we should present something on this so we can have something a little more rigid.

We now have enough examples to figure out stuff.

Previous relevant post: [Edgeware rate cards](https://gov.edgewa.re/discussion/544-edgeware-rate-cards-aka-how-to-value-contributions)

Thank you for the comments [@mrbulb](/edgeware/account/jXC7ghviUzVcVySg3eD8prB7C9m6VzK6cw2MTyMTDTUye5q) and @moonrocket, honestly I agree with what you say. You can always print a downloaded copy of a painting and call it your own, but that wouldn’t give you original work. 

It’s about the quality of the work that counts. Most of our time is spent on crafting the content and making sure it’s digestible by regular audience. Slapping an image is the easier part of the process to be honest. 

And it’s not just us saying, you can take a look at the feedback our work has gotten on social media, especially twitter.

Regarding what rich say, the team should come up with a solution and put that out to the community and proceed with that.

Thank you very much for the counter offer. This sounds perfect, We will make sure to increase the amount of information to the 3x as mentioned by rich in discord from the next post. I will make sure to create more crafted content in that amount  in the coming days. Looking forward to your support.
